title: QR code generator built with Claude
description: Simon used Claude to build a QR code generator tool for creating scannable codes for URLs, text, or WiFi networks. The tool includes options for network name, password, security type, style, size, and color. An example of 'vibe coding' - quickly building practical tools with AI assistance.
author: Simon Willison

title: GitLab Act 2: Restructuring for the agentic era
description: GitLab announces significant restructuring for the agentic era: reducing countries by 30%, flattening management by removing up to 3 layers, reorganizing into 60 smaller empowered teams with end-to-end ownership. They argue 'the agentic era multiplies demand for software' and that as software production costs collapse, demand will expand. Stock price has dropped 50% in a year, raising questions about this optimistic outlook.
author: Simon Willison

title: Your AI coding agent needs to reduce maintenance costs
description: James Shore argues that AI coding agents must reduce maintenance costs to be viable. If you double code output with AI but maintain or increase maintenance costs, you're trading temporary speed for permanent indenture. The math only works if LLMs decrease maintenance costs by exactly the inverse of the rate they add code.
author: James Shore (covered by Simon Willison)

title: Learning on the Shop floor: Shopify's River coding agent
description: Tobias Lütke describes Shopify's internal coding agent tool, River, which operates entirely in public on their Slack. River doesn't respond to direct messages, insisting on public channels where anyone can watch and learn. This creates a 'Lehrwerkstatt' (teaching workshop) environment where osmosis learning happens - everyone learns from watching AI-assisted work. Similar to Midjourney's early Discord-based approach.
author: Simon Willison (discussing Tobias Lütke)

title: LLM coding workflow going into 2026 - Hacker News Discussion
description: Hacker News discussion about multi-step AI pipelines for 3D mesh generation with validation stages. Community highlights challenges with LLMs skipping edge cases or taking suboptimal paths, and debates the practical efficiency of AI coding assistance.
author: Hacker News Community
